title: 09. Production & Safety: Retry Logic & Exponential Backoff
summary: APIs fail transiently — network hiccup, rate limit hit, server overload. Retry logic automatically retries failed calls with exponential backoff (increasing wait times) so temporary issues don't cause permanent failures.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > APIs fail transiently — network hiccup, rate limit hit, server overload. Retry logic **automatically retries** failed calls with **exponential backoff** (increasing wait times) so temporary issues don't cause permanent failures.

sections.title: Retry Logic Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              RETRY LOGIC + EXPONENTIAL BACKOFF                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  WITHOUT RETRY:                      WITH RETRY:
  ──────────────────────              ─────────────────────────────
  Call → 429 Rate Limited             Call → 429 Rate Limited
  → Return error to user              → Wait 1 second → Retry
  User sees: "Service error" ❌       → 429 again
                                      → Wait 2 seconds → Retry
                                      → 429 again
                                      → Wait 4 seconds → Retry
                                      → ✅ Success!
                                      User sees: answer (delayed) ✅

  EXPONENTIAL BACKOFF FORMULA:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  wait_time = base_delay * (2 ^ attempt) + random_jitter

  Attempt 1: 1 * 2^1 + jitter = ~2s
  Attempt 2: 1 * 2^2 + jitter = ~4s
  Attempt 3: 1 * 2^3 + jitter = ~8s
  Attempt 4: 1 * 2^4 + jitter = ~16s
  Max wait:  capped at 60 seconds

  WHY JITTER? Without jitter, all retrying clients
  retry at the EXACT same time → thundering herd!
  Jitter spreads them out → server recovers.

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  WHICH ERRORS TO RETRY:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ✅ RETRY:                           ❌ DON'T RETRY:
  429 Rate Limited                    400 Bad Request
  500 Internal Server Error           401 Unauthorized
  502 Bad Gateway                     403 Forbidden
  503 Service Unavailable             404 Not Found
  504 Gateway Timeout                 422 Validation Error
  ConnectionTimeout                   (these won't fix themselves)
  NetworkError
```
